steps.title: Sex-determination genes
steps.narration: Neurons with high fruitless or doublesex expression mark the courtship nervous system across brain and VNC.

steps.title: P1 command cluster
steps.narration: pC1 cells are the male courtship command cluster. They sit in the central brain and drive the rest of this pathway.

steps.title: mAL
steps.narration: Male-specific mAL neurons couple the command cluster to downstream courtship circuitry.

steps.title: Descending courtship
steps.narration: pIP10, aSP22, and DNp13 carry courtship and song commands out of the brain, down the neck, into the VNC.

steps.title: Song motor
steps.narration: vPR6 and TN1c neurons in the ventral nerve cord pattern courtship song.

steps.title: Visual tracking
steps.narration: LC10 visual projection neurons track a moving fly and feed the same courtship cluster.
